differences: The table's months column (the age used in the authors' models) disagrees with its own age_y and age_m columns, and with the ages in Appendix B of the paper, for 3 of the 30 children with speech sound disorders; age here comes from age_y and age_m, which match Appendix B for all 59 children. The paper's mean age for these children (8;2) is closer to the months column (8;1.7) than to Appendix B (8;1.2); both are within the month the checks allow.
The paper gives the BPVS standard scores of the typically developing children as mean 103, SD 14; the 29 scores of Appendix A, which equal the table, give mean 102.2 and SD 14.7.

The table's Diagnosis column is blank for 6 children and shows a dash for one whom Appendix B lists with an articulation disorder; participants.csv takes the diagnosis from Appendix B, which gives the paper's counts (16 articulation disorder ...). The table's recruited column also puts two children whose codes begin with LN under GR; it is not used.
The paper gives the age range of the children with speech sound disorders as 5;0 to 12;11; the youngest child in the table and in Appendix B is 5;2.
The paper says typically developing children produced each consonant once; the table has a second repetition (rep 2) for some of their tokens.
The paper's mixed-model estimates (Table 1) were not recomputed.
